item.title: Pilgrimage and Good Luck: Unlocking Nikko Toshogu Shrine Through Fruits Basket! The Healing Power Behind the 'Sleeping Cat's' Reversal and the Eight-Panel Story of the 'Three Wise Monkeys' ☀️
item.description: Nikko Toshogu Shrine echoes the Chinese zodiac myth at the heart of Fruits Basket. Sun-chan explains the healing power found in the story of the Sleeping Cat and the eight life-stage carvings of the Three Wise Monkeys at the Sacred Stable.

item.title: 【聖地巡礼×開運】『フルーツバスケット』で紐解く日光東照宮！「眠り猫」の逆転劇と「三猿」8枚の物語に秘められた人生の癒やしパワー☀️
item.description: 『フルーツバスケット』の十二支神話と重なる日光東照宮。国宝「眠り猫」の物語と、神厩舎「三猿」8面に描かれた人生の歩みから、癒やしと開運のヒントを太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Pilgrimage and Good Luck: Tracing the Sites Connected to Inuyasha | The Soul-Purifying Power Taught by Fushimi Inari's Sacred Jewel and Shinto's 'Ichirei Shikon'
item.description: The Shikon Jewel and the priestess's warding arrows in Inuyasha echo Fushimi Inari's sacred jewel and Shinto's view of the soul, Ichirei Shikon. Sun-chan explains the good-luck hints found in these legends, together with Kuzunoha Inari and Hozan-ji.

item.title: 【聖地巡礼×開運】『犬夜叉』ゆかりの地を辿る！伏見稲荷の「宝珠」と神道の「一霊四魂」が教える魂の浄化パワー
item.description: 『犬夜叉』の四魂の玉や巫女の破魔矢に息づく、伏見稲荷の宝珠や神道の霊魂観「一霊四魂」。葛葉稲荷・寳山寺の伝承とあわせて、魂を整える開運のヒントを太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Pilgrimage and Good Luck: Exploring the Sites Connected to Spirited Away! The 'Misogi' Purification of the Gods and Cleansing Power Behind Dogo Onsen Honkan and the Edo-Tokyo Open Air Architectural Museum
item.description: Dogo Onsen Honkan and the Edo-Tokyo Open Air Architectural Museum are said to be among the inspirations for Spirited Away. Sun-chan explains the reverence for the gods and the purification ritual of Misogi behind these two sacred, cleansing power spots.

item.title: 【聖地巡礼×開運】『千と千尋の神隠し』ゆかりの地へ！道後温泉本館＆江戸東京たてもの園に秘められた「神々の禊（みそぎ）」と浄化パワー
item.description: 『千と千尋の神隠し』のモデルの一つと言われる道後温泉本館と江戸東京たてもの園。八百万の神々への畏敬と「禊」の儀礼に秘められた浄化・開運パワーを太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Tokyo's Most Powerful Money Luck Shrine: Hebikubo Shrine | The Secret of 'Rebirth and Success' Granted by the White Snake and Dragon God
item.description: Hebikubo Shrine in Shinagawa, Tokyo, is home to a White Snake deity that sheds its skin and is reborn, and a Dragon God that ascends to the heavens. Sun-chan explains its highlights, including the snake-petting stone and the money-washing ritual, and its blessings for wealth and career success.

item.title: 東京・蛇窪神社の見どころとご利益｜白蛇と龍神が導く金運・立身出世のパワースポット
item.description: 品川の蛇窪神社は、脱皮して生まれ変わる白蛇様と天へ昇る龍神様が宿る東京屈指のパワースポット。なで白蛇や銭洗いなど見どころと金運・立身出世のご利益を太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Pilgrimage and Good Luck: Exploring the Sites Connected to Demon Slayer! The Truth Behind 'Sealing the Demon Gate and Warding Off Evil' at Kamado Shrine in Dazaifu and Senso-ji Temple
item.description: Kamado Shrine in Dazaifu and Senso-ji Temple in Tokyo are both known as pilgrimage sites for Demon Slayer fans. Sun-chan explains the good luck origins behind these two sacred sites, from sealing the demon gate and matchmaking to the guardian Wind and Thunder Gods.

item.title: 【聖地巡礼×開運】『鬼滅の刃』ゆかりの地を巡る！太宰府・竈門神社＆浅草寺に秘められた「鬼門封じと厄除け」の真実
item.description: 『鬼滅の刃』ファンの聖地として知られる太宰府・竈門神社と東京・浅草寺。鬼門封じと縁結び、風神雷神の結界など、2つの聖地に秘められた開運の由来を太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Pilgrimage and Good Luck: Exploring the Sites Connected to Your Name. | The 'Musubi' and Ancient Nature Worship Living On at Lake Suwa, Suwa Taisha Shrine, and Hida-Furukawa
item.description: Lake Suwa, Suwa Taisha Shrine, and Hida-Furukawa are said to be among the inspirations behind Your Name. Sun-chan explains the view at Kataware-doki, the teaching of Musubi, the kumihimo braiding craft, and the good luck rooted in these sacred sites.

item.title: 【聖地巡礼×開運】『君の名は。』ゆかりの地を巡る！諏訪湖・諏訪大社＆飛騨古川に息づく「ムスビ」と太古の自然信仰
item.description: 『君の名は。』の舞台モデルの一つと言われる諏訪湖・諏訪大社と飛騨古川。かたわれ時の絶景やムスビの教え、組紐の文化など、聖地に息づく開運の由来を太陽ちゃんが解説します。

item.title: Seimei Shrine (Seimei Jinja) in Kyoto: Highlights and Blessings | The Ultimate Protection Power Spot of the Five-Pointed Star and Yin-Yang Five Elements
item.description: Seimei Shrine in Kyoto enshrines the legendary onmyoji Abe no Seimei and is considered one of Japan's most powerful spots for warding off bad luck. Sun-chan explains its five-pointed star barrier, Seimei Well, and other highlights and blessings.

item.title: 京都・晴明神社の見どころとご利益｜五芒星の結界と陰陽五行の最強厄除けパワースポット
item.description: 京都・晴明神社は、陰陽師の安倍晴明を祀る最強の厄除けパワースポット。五芒星の結界や晴明井、厄除桃などの見どころと、陰陽五行に基づくご利益を太陽ちゃんが分かりやすく解説します。

item.title: [Hiroo] A Secret Spot in a Stylish Town!? Get 'Miracle Survival Power' and a 'Magical Ink Dragon' at Hiroo Inari Shrine 🐉✨
item.description: Just a 2-minute walk from Hiroo Station. We explore the charm of 'Hiroo Inari Shrine,' a different dimension nestled in the embassy district. Sun-chan thoroughly explains its survival power-filled highlights, like Yuichi Takahashi's ink dragon painting and the miracle ginkgo tree, plus good luck advice!

item.title: 【広尾】おしゃれ街の秘密スポット！？廣尾稲荷神社で「奇跡のサバイバルパワー」と「魔法の墨龍」を手に入れよう🐉✨
item.description: 広尾駅徒歩2分。大使館街に佇む異空間「廣尾稲荷神社」の魅力に迫ります。高橋由一の墨龍図や奇跡のイチョウなど、サバイバルパワーあふれる見どころと開運アドバイスを太陽ちゃんが徹底解説！
